[[Image:Bay of Storms.jpg|thumb|Bay of Storms]]
The '''Bay of Storms''' is a portion of the [[Great Sea]] off the eastern coast of [[Kalimdor]], mostly noted by travelers on the eastern coast of the [[Azshara]]. It is the location of [[Scalebeard's Cave]], [[Hetaera's Clutch]], and the [[Temple of Arkkoran]]. The bay is located around the area of {{co|53|55|Azshara}}.
